# Ganga Beauty Parlour

> Premier bridal makeup studio and luxury beauty salon in Sujangarh and Didwana, Rajasthan, founded and directed by Lead Makeup Artist Ganga Manish Soni.

## Overview
- **Business Name**: Ganga Beauty Parlour
- **Founder & Lead Artist**: Ganga Manish Soni
- **Tagline**: Premier Bridal & Luxury Beauty Studio · Sujangarh
- **Official Production Website**: https://gangabeautyparlour.com/
- **Primary Phone & WhatsApp**: +91 77330 79941
- **Secondary Phone**: +91 70142 21824
- **Opening Hours**: Monday - Sunday: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM IST
- **Serving Regions**: Sujangarh, Didwana, Ladnun, and nearby areas across Rajasthan, India.
- **Booking Channel**: Direct WhatsApp reservations (no admin panel, no user login required).

## Appointment & Booking Workflow
- **Booking Flow**: Customers select their desired branch, service, date, and preferred time slot on the website, agree to booking terms, and tap "Book Appointment on WhatsApp".
- **Instant WhatsApp Link**: https://wa.me/917733079941
- **Bridal Slot Reservation**: 30% advance deposit is required to confirm high-demand wedding dates.
